# Siemens

> Siemens delivers AI-powered digital transformation solutions across manufacturing, infrastructure, and mobility through digital twins, industrial automation, and intelligent software platforms.

Siemens is a global technology leader providing enterprise software, automation, and digitalization solutions. The site showcases core products like SIMATIC virtual PLCs and GridScale X, along with case studies demonstrating real-world AI and digital twin implementations across industries.

## Key Topics

- Digital Transformation
- Artificial Intelligence
- Digital Twin
- Industrial AI
- Siemens Xcelerator
- SIMATIC S7-1500V Virtual PLC
- Industrial Edge
- Factory Automation
- GridScale X
- Smart Manufacturing
- Non-Revenue Water
- Building X
- Operational Efficiency
- Product Development
- Sustainability

## Core Technologies & Platforms

- [Digital transformation](https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/digital-transformation): Digital transformation strategy: AI, digital twins, cloud, and data analytics.
- [Artificial intelligence solutions](https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/artificial-intelligence): Siemens AI solutions overview: intelligent agents, robotics, and generative design.
- [Digital twin: The living blueprint](https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/digital-twin): Digital twin technology overview with real-time feedback and AI-powered prediction.
- [Digital Enterprise](https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/insights/digital-enterprise): Digital Enterprise overview: digital transformation with AI and digital twins.

## Industrial Automation & Manufacturing

## Infrastructure & Utilities

- [Gridscale X](https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/gridscale-x): GridScale X grid management software for autonomous operations and optimization.
- [Non-revenue Water](https://www.siemens.com/en-us/industries/water/non-revenue-water): Non-revenue water solutions using AI leak detection and meter data management.
- [A case for AI: Water pipeline leaks](https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/insights/va-syd-water-artificial-intelligence): VA SYD water utility case study using SIWA Leak Finder AI for pipeline management.
- [A practical demo to reduce non-revenue water](https://resources.sw.siemens.com/en-US/a-practical-demo-to-reduce-non-revenue-water): Webinar and best practices for reducing non-revenue water with digital solutions.
